title: Data Table Sheet
description: A row detail side sheet for the data table: every field of the selected row with typed cell renderers, per-value filter and copy actions, and arrow-key navigation between rows.
docs:
Installed the row sheet in `components/data-table/data-table-sheet/`: `DataTableSheetDetails` (the side sheet with previous, next and close) and `MemoizedDataTableSheetContent` (the fields of a row), plus the typed cell renderers in `data-table-cell/` they use. It needs the `data-table` item (installed with it).

First, put `DataTableSheetDetails` inside `DataTableProvider` (or pass it as `DataTableInfinite`'s `sheetSlot`), find the selected row from `rowSelection`, and render `MemoizedDataTableSheetContent` with `table`, `data`, `filterFields` and your `SheetField[]` (`readonly` for values that are not filters).

- Copy actions toast through `sonner`: mount a `<Toaster />` once (`npx shadcn@latest add sonner`).
- The sheet slides in from the inline end; set `dir="rtl"` on `<html>` to mirror it.

props.name: title
props.description: DataTableSheetDetails: the heading of the sheet, usually from the selected row.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: DataTableSheetDetails: classes for the title, for example font-mono.

props.name: fields
props.description: Content: each field's `id`, `label`, `type` (`readonly`, or the filter type to offer filter actions) and an optional `display` (`text`, `code`, `badge`, `number`, `boolean`, `timestamp`, `status-code`, `level-indicator`, `bar`, `heatmap`, `star`) or `component`.

props.name: data
props.description: Content: the selected row; a skeleton renders while it is undefined.

props.name: table / filterFields
props.description: Content: the table the filter actions apply to and its filter fields.

props.name: metadata
props.description: Content: extra values passed to custom field components.

a11y: A modal Radix dialog: focus moves into the sheet, stays there while it is open and returns to the row on close.
The arrow keys move to the previous and next row; the up, down and close buttons have accessible names and tooltips.
Each filterable field is one menu button named by its label and value ("Status up"); Enter opens the actions (include, ranges, same hour or day, copy). Read-only fields are plain text.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the sheet and its overlay appear without sliding or fading.
